description: Conditional-required: a field is required only when another field's value meets a rule. The FOURTH Criteria/Condition owner family — owner key FieldValidation (same owner as a plain validation rule), distinct from ColumnVisibility used for conditional VISIBILITY. Unlike branch/goto Expressions this rule is an inline KRE formula STRING in RHSValue (not a Node-AST), referencing fields BY NAME as ${'form.FieldName'}. Captured live off a copilot build 2026-08-13 (#57). Graph-verified; RUNTIME enforcement UNVERIFIED (no live item walk).

Condition_Sample01.ErrorMessage: Target is required when Trigger is Option A

notes: Owner-family: this is a FieldValidation-owned Criteria (chain Field -> FieldValidation::Criteria -> Criteria{FieldValidation} -> Criteria::Condition -> Condition{Criteria}, back-refs bidirectional) — the SAME owner key as a plain string-length/range validation rule (shapes/field_validation_criteria.json), NOT the ColumnVisibility owner used for conditional VISIBILITY (shapes/criteria_column_visibility.json). Conditional-required is modelled as a conditional VALIDATION rule, not a `Required:true` flag flip.

The rule is an inline KRE formula STRING in RHSValue, NOT a Node-AST subtree (unlike branch/goto Expressions). Fields are referenced BY NAME as ${'form.<FieldName>'}, never by Field id. Distinguishing wire keys: Operator:'EXPRESSION', RHSType:'Value', HasArguments:true.

Formula shape: if(<trigger condition>, <required assertion>, true) — returns true (valid) when the trigger does not apply, else asserts the target is non-null (`${'form.Target'} != null`). The `true` else-branch is what makes the field optional in the non-triggering case.

Field NAMES inside the KRE string ('Trigger','Target') are display names, not node ids — case-sensitive and unvalidated by the write API (same silent-mismatch trap as any literal; read the real field names, never guess).

RUNTIME UNVERIFIED (THE RULE): the graph landed coherent but was NOT walked through a submit to confirm it actually blocks/allows. Owed: a live item walk that submits with the trigger set and the target blank, expecting a block.
Copilot structural builds AUTO-PUBLISH the draft without being asked — snapshot expecting the flow to already be live afterward.
